description: This file defines classes and constants for handling WebIDL types, including various IDL type classes, union types, array types, record types, nullable types, and promise types. It is used for parsing, representing, and resolving WebIDL type information within a codebase.

classes.name: IdlTypeBase
classes.description: Base class for various IDL type representations, providing common interface and default behaviors.

classes.name: IdlType
classes.description: Represents a basic IDL type with properties to determine its category (e.g., primitive, callback, dictionary, enum, interface).

classes.name: IdlUnionType
classes.description: Represents a union of multiple IDL types, with methods to flatten nested unions and determine nullable types.

classes.name: IdlArrayOrSequenceType
classes.description: Base class for array-like IDL types, including array, sequence, and frozen array types.

classes.name: IdlRecordType
classes.description: Represents a record type with key and value types.

classes.name: IdlNullableType
classes.description: Wraps another IDL type to indicate nullability (e.g., 'Type?').

classes.name: IdlPromiseType
classes.description: Represents a Promise type wrapping a result type.

methods.name: inherits_interface
methods.description: Checks if an interface inherits from an ancestor.

methods.name: set_ancestors
methods.description: Sets the inheritance hierarchy for interfaces.
